n: Privacy-first LLM smart home on Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm)
t: A free Arm guide to build a local smart home assistant on a Pi 5.
steps: Find the Arm Learning Path named Build a Privacy-First LLM Smart Home on Raspberry Pi 5.
Gather a Raspberry Pi 5, a breadboard, LEDs, resistors, and jumper wires.
Install Python and Ollama while online.
Wire an LED and test the GPIO pins.
Go offline and test a request.
